title: Computing the Add-On Down Payment
content:
Patient Financial Services calculation note — **Patient Payment Plans**: the amount of the add-on down payment on an invoice added to an accepted plan whose term's down-payment percentage is above zero. On a term whose down-payment percentage is zero, the amount is nil.

## The rule

The add-on down payment is the plan term's down-payment percentage of the balance due on the invoice being added, raised by one quarter when one installment was recorded missed on the plan less than 12 whole months before today and by one half when two or more were, the product rounded to the nearest cent, an exact half cent being rounded up.

The add-on down payment is never less than the add-on minimum of 25.00; when the amount worked out is lower, the add-on down payment is the add-on minimum.

## The quantities

- **Plan term's down-payment percentage** — the down-payment percentage of the plan's term, as the term schedule gives it.
- **Balance due on the invoice being added** — the balance due that the open invoice shows in Patient Invoices & Statements.
- **Missed installments** — the missed-installment lines on the plan ledger dated less than 12 whole months before today.
- **Raise** — none when there is no such line; one quarter (a multiplier of 1.25) when there is exactly one; one half (a multiplier of 1.5) when there are two or more.

The balance due is multiplied by the percentage and by the raise multiplier, the product is rounded once, to the nearest cent, and only then compared with 25.00; the add-on down payment is the higher of the two.

## Worked figures (hypothetical invoices)

| Term percentage | Invoice balance due | Missed lines in the last 12 whole months | Product before rounding | Rounded | Add-on down payment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10 | 437.50 | 0 | 43.75 | 43.75 | 43.75 |
| 10 | 437.50 | 1 | 54.6875 | 54.69 | 54.69 |
| 10 | 437.50 | 3 | 65.625 | 65.63 | 65.63 |
| 15 | 300.00 | 0 | 45.00 | 45.00 | 45.00 |
| 10 | 180.00 | 0 | 18.00 | 18.00 | 25.00 (the add-on minimum) |
| 10 | 180.00 | 2 | 27.00 | 27.00 | 27.00 |

Reading the third row: 437.50 multiplied by 10 percent is 43.75; raised by one half it is 65.625, which rounds up at the half cent to 65.63. A missed-installment line dated 12 or more whole months ago is outside the span and adds no raise.
